items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-06-15
items.q: Well, Georgie used to play some time. Sometimes. Sometimes.

ctx.x: You told me about Georgie Falkle on something.

Well, Georgie used to play some time. Sometimes. Sometimes. He was in love with how I would work the piano. In other words, we didn't have no piano. We used the piano after the job and qualified for piano. The music. Talking about those pianos, did you ever, did they have
any player pianos around you? You know, the piano? The Rhodes?
